item.title: Angelini Pharma Acquisition of Catalyst Pharmaceuticals
item.description:
• Summary: Italian pharmaceutical company Angelini Pharma has agreed to acquire Catalyst Pharmaceuticals for approximately $4.1 billion, gaining access to the U.S. rare disease market and bolstering its neurology portfolio. The deal centers on Catalyst's flagship drug Firdapse (amifampridine) for Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome, along with development-stage assets.
  • MoAs: N/A (acquisition theme)
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, BioPharma Dive, BioSpace, Endpoints News, STAT News

item.title: Roche Acquisition of PathAI
item.description:
• Summary: Roche has agreed to acquire PathAI, a digital pathology and AI-driven diagnostics company, in a deal potentially worth over $1 billion with upfront and milestone payments. The acquisition aims to integrate PathAI's technology into Roche's diagnostics and drug development workflows.
  • MoAs: N/A (acquisition theme)
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive

item.title: GSK Acquisition of Chinese siRNA Specialist
item.description:
• Summary: GSK has agreed to acquire a Chinese siRNA specialist for approximately $1 billion, expanding its capabilities beyond weight loss into RNA-based therapeutics. The acquisition underscores GSK's strategy to leverage siRNA technology for targeting a wide range of diseases.
  • MoAs: N/A (acquisition theme; siRNA technology involves silencing disease-related genes via small interfering RNA).
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: BeOne Therapeutics Shelves Programs
item.description:
• Summary: BeOne Therapeutics shelves five cancer programs and halts its phase 2 rheumatoid arthritis trial, as reported by Fierce Biotech. The strategic pivot reflects a focus on other pipeline assets.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Ascendis Axes IL-2 Program
item.description:
• Summary: Ascendis Pharma discontinues its IL-2 program and retreats from oncology expansion, as reported by Fierce Biotech. The decision aligns with a focus on its endocrinology pipeline.
  • MoAs: IL-2 immunotherapy (immune stimulation via interleukin-2 receptor agonism)
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Amgen and Novartis Manufacturing Moves
item.description:
• Summary: Amgen adds $300 million to its Puerto Rico budget for manufacturing expansion, while Novartis plans to exit an oral drug factory in Germany, as reported by Endpoints News.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Gilead Wipes Out Most of Arcellx Workforce
item.description:
• Summary: Gilead Sciences eliminates most of the workforce at Arcellx, a cell therapy company, as reported by BioSpace. The move follows a strategic re-evaluation of the partnership.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Insulet CEO Details Scrubs Device Promotion
item.description:
• Summary: Insulet's CEO details a scrubs-based device promotion that boosts awareness and education for its insulin pump technology, as reported by Fierce Pharma.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Alnylam Rebuked by FDA Over Efficacy Claims for Amvuttra
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA rebukes Alnylam Pharmaceuticals over efficacy claims for Amvuttra (vutrisiran) on its website, as reported by Fierce Pharma. The agency cited misleading communication regarding the drug's benefits for hATTR amyloidosis.
  • MoAs: RNA interference (siRNA targeting transthyretin mRNA, reducing TTR protein production)
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma
